title: Backend Dockerfile (Multi-stage Build)
goal: Create production-ready Dockerfile with multi-stage build to minimize image size, separate build and runtime dependencies, and optimize for security.

sub_tasks.title: Create Multi-stage Dockerfile
sub_tasks.output: Implemented multi-stage build with separate builder and production stages

sub_tasks.title: Optimize Layer Caching
sub_tasks.output: Structured COPY commands to leverage Docker layer caching for package.json and dependencies before copying source code

sub_tasks.title: Generate Prisma Client in Build
sub_tasks.output: Prisma client generated during Docker build, production dependencies only in final image

sub_tasks.title: Configure Production Runtime
sub_tasks.output: Final image uses Node.js LTS, runs as non-root user, exposes port, sets NODE_ENV=production

acceptance_criteria: Multi-stage Dockerfile with builder and production stages
Prisma client generation included in build process
Layer caching optimized (package.json copied before source)
Production image contains only necessary files
result_summary: Production-optimized Dockerfile created with multi-stage build pattern. Builder stage handles TypeScript compilation and Prisma client generation with devDependencies. Final production image contains only runtime dependencies and compiled code, significantly reducing image size. Follows Docker best practices: layer caching, non-root user, minimal attack surface.
